$comment: Licences allowed in dependencies of this AGPL-3.0 project. Read by license-check.mjs and the dependency-review action. Anything not listed (SSPL, BUSL, CC-BY-NC, UNLICENSED, unknown) fails. Add a package to exceptions only with a reason.

exceptions.@sentry/cli-darwin@3.8.2: Build-time only (apps/web/scripts/sourcemaps.mjs uploads source maps when a Sentry token is set); never in the bundle or a self-hosted runtime. FSL-1.1 allows any use except a product competing with Sentry, and each release becomes MIT two years after publication. Pinned to this version so an upgrade is reviewed again (#553). 3.8.2 reviewed: same licence and same use.
